text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even in a G1 race, Shinko Windy<n>doesn't fail to run
impressively.<n>Public perception of her hasn't
changed much, but it's clear she has<n>some fans in
her corner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having watched Shinko Windy's race<n>on TV from
summer camp, Biko<n>Pegasus asks her where she
finds<n>the strength to keep on running even<n>while
being heckled.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy explains that she just<n>needs to stay
patient until she can<n>realize her ambitions, even if it
means<n>being treated as a walking meme in<n>the
meantime.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Recognizing the strength of her<n>resolve, I decide
that rather than<n>rushing into another G1, we could
use<n>a race that'll let her showcase her<n>talent
instead—a race like the Tokai<n>Stakes.
